requirements.text: Adding a product that is already in the cart increases that line's quantity by one instead of adding a second line.
Discount codes are case-insensitive: "SAVE10", "save10" and "Save10" all apply the same 10% discount.
When the last item is removed, the cart shows the message "Your cart is empty".
Shipping costs $5.00 per order. Orders whose subtotal before discounts is $50.00 or more ship free. An empty cart shows $0.00 shipping.
Signed-in customers can open an "Order history" page that lists their past orders with the date and total of each.

requirement.text: Adding a product that is already in the cart increases that line's quantity by one instead of adding a second line.

findings.explanation: addItem in src/cart/cart.js finds an existing line by productId and increments its quantity instead of adding a new line.

requirement.text: Discount codes are case-insensitive: "SAVE10", "save10" and "Save10" all apply the same 10% discount.

findings.explanation: src/cart/discounts.js stores only the exact key "SAVE10" in a Map and does not normalize the input's case before lookup, so "save10" or "Save10" will not match and the discount won't apply.

requirement.text: When the last item is removed, the cart shows the message "Your cart is empty".

findings.explanation: index.html contains a #cart-empty element with text "Your cart is empty" and app.js toggles its hidden attribute based on isEmpty(cart), showing it when the cart has no lines.

requirement.text: Shipping costs $5.00 per order. Orders whose subtotal before discounts is $50.00 or more ship free. An empty cart shows $0.00 shipping.

findings.explanation: src/checkout/shipping.js uses a strict greater-than check (`subtotal > FREE_SHIPPING_FROM`), so an order with a subtotal of exactly $50.00 is charged the $5.00 shipping fee instead of shipping free as required.

requirement.text: Signed-in customers can open an "Order history" page that lists their past orders with the date and total of each.

findings.explanation: No account/order history page or related code exists in index.html, src/app.js, or any other shown files; there's no sign-in flow or order persistence to support listing past orders.

requirement.text: The 'Place order' button is disabled unless the cart has at least one item and the email field contains a valid email address (name@domain.tld).

quote.snippet: The "Place order" button stays disabled until the cart has at least one item and the email field contains a valid email address (name@domain.tld).

findings.explanation: canPlaceOrder in src/checkout/place-order.js only checks that the email field is non-empty, not that it matches a valid email format (name@domain.tld), so the button can be enabled with invalid email text.

requirement.text: Clicking the enabled 'Place order' button shows the message 'Thanks! Your order is placed.'

quote.snippet: Once it is enabled, clicking it shows "Thanks! Your order is placed."

findings.explanation: The checkout-form submit handler in src/app.js sets the order-confirmation text to 'Thanks! Your order is placed.' when the enabled Place order button is clicked.
